expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: sessions held in the web servers' memory logged members out
when a request reached the other server and on every deploy, which is why sessions live in Postgres.
expectations.evidence: The agent states that in 2023 sessions lived in each server's memory, that members were logged out whenever a request reached the other server, and that “Every deploy logged everyone out.” It explains that an in-process dict would bring back both problems fixed by keeping sessions in Postgres, and asks for confirmation before making the change.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md at step 3; first edit at step None
